title: Concept: Workspace includes a module from outside the repository
description: go.work declares a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.work (go).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
